newsitem.title: USA: NCBA rejects name change to Beef USA.
newsitem.headline: NCBA rejects name change to Beef USA.

text.p: The National Cattlemen's Beef Association said on Wednesday it has rejected a proposal for its name to be changed to Beef USA.

The proposal had been backed by the NCBA Executive Committee but failed to gain the necessary two-thirds majority needed at a meeting of the NCBA Board of Directors on Wednesday, a statement issued by the organization said.

NCBA was formed a year ago after the merger of the National Cattlemen's Association and the National Livestock and Meat Board. Following the merger a task force was appointed to consider options for a new name and choose "Beef USA" with the tagline "America's Cattle Industry."
